#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
using ll = long long;
using ld = long double;

const int MOD = 1000000007;

struct ModInt {
    int val;
    ModInt() : val(0) {}
    ModInt(long long v) : val((v % MOD + MOD) % MOD) {}
    explicit operator int() const { return val; }
};

ModInt operator+(const ModInt& a, const ModInt& b) { return ModInt((a.val + b.val) % MOD); }
ModInt operator-(const ModInt& a, const ModInt& b) { return ModInt((a.val - b.val + MOD) % MOD); }
ModInt operator*(const ModInt& a, const ModInt& b) { return ModInt((ll)a.val * b.val % MOD); }
ModInt& operator+=(ModInt& a, const ModInt& b) { return a = a + b; }
ModInt& operator-=(ModInt& a, const ModInt& b) { return a = a - b; }
ModInt& operator*=(ModInt& a, const ModInt& b) { return a = a * b; }

ModInt modPow(ModInt base, int exp) {
    ModInt res(1);
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) res *= base;
        base *= base;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return res;
}

ModInt modInv(const ModInt& a) { return modPow(a, MOD - 2); }
ModInt operator/(const ModInt& a, const ModInt& b) { return a * modInv(b); }

const int MAX_N = 1024000;
ModInt fact[MAX_N], invFact[MAX_N];

void initFactorials(int n = MAX_N) {
    fact[0] = ModInt(1);
    invFact[0] = ModInt(1);
    for (int i = 1; i < n; ++i) {
        fact[i] = fact[i-1] * ModInt(i);
        invFact[i] = invFact[i-1] / ModInt(i);
    }
}

ModInt comb(int n, int r) {
    if (r < 0 || r > n) return ModInt(0);
    return fact[n] * invFact[r] * invFact[n - r];
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);

    vector<vector<ModInt>> pers(6, vector<ModInt>(6));
    
    // Read N
    int N;
    cin >> N;
    int s = 3 - (N + 1) / 2;
    
    for (int i = 0; i < s; ++i) {
        pers[i][i] = ModInt(1);
    }
    
    for (int i = s; i < s + N; ++i) {
        for (int j = s; j < s + N; ++j) {
            int p;
            cin >> p;
            pers[i][j] = ModInt(p) / ModInt(100);
        }
    }
    
    for (int i = s + N; i < 6; ++i) {
        pers[i][i] = ModInt(1);
    }

    // Generate all permutations of {0,0,0,1,1,1}
    vector<int> v = {0, 0, 0, 1, 1, 1};
    map<int, int> permMap;
    int id = 0;
    do {
        int mask = 0;
        for (int k = 0; k < 6; ++k) {
            if (v[k]) mask |= (1 << k);
        }
        permMap[mask] = id++;
    } while (next_permutation(v.begin(), v.end()));

    // Solve for upper and lower parts
    auto solve = [&](int offset) -> vector<ModInt> {
        vector<ModInt> result(1 << 20, ModInt(0));
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 18); ++mask) {
            vector<vector<int>> haves(3, vector<int>(6, 0));
            ModInt prob(1);
            
            for (int i = 0; i < 3; ++i) {
                for (int j = 0; j < 6; ++j) {
                    int idx = i * 6 + j;
                    if (mask & (1 << idx)) {
                        haves[i][j] = 1;
                        prob *= pers[offset + i][j];
                    } else {
                        prob *= (ModInt(1) - pers[offset + i][j]);
                    }
                }
            }
            
            int flags = 0;
            for (int i = 0; i < 6; ++i) {
                if (!haves[0][i]) continue;
                for (int j = 0; j < 6; ++j) {
                    if (!haves[1][j]) continue;
                    if (i == j) continue;
                    for (int k = 0; k < 6; ++k) {
                        if (!haves[2][k]) continue;
                        if (i == k || j == k) continue;
                        int anum = (1 << i) ^ (1 << j) ^ (1 << k);
                        flags |= (1 << permMap[anum]);
                    }
                }
            }
            result[flags] += prob;
        }
        return result;
    };

    auto upper = solve(0);
    auto lower = solve(3);

    // FWT-style summation for lower
    for (int bit = 1; bit < (1 << 20); bit <<= 1) {
        for (int i = 0; i < (1 << 20); ++i) {
            if (!(i & bit)) {
                lower[i ^ bit] += lower[i];
            }
        }
    }

    ModInt answer(0);
    for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << 20); ++mask) {
        if (upper[mask].val == 0) continue;
        
        int need = 0;
        for (int x = 0; x < 20; ++x) {
            if (mask & (1 << x)) {
                need |= (1 << (19 - x));
            }
        }
        
        int complement = ((1 << 20) - 1) ^ need;
        ModInt term = upper[mask] * (ModInt(1) - lower[complement]);
        answer += term;
    }

    cout << answer.val << '\n';
    return 0;
}
